items.claim: The opponent is exceptionally strong physically and difficult to escape once he secures a hold.
items.quote: multiple guys say how strong he is physically. Um and once he gets hold of guys they don't seem to be able to escape.

items.claim: Ian Garry is very tough to get hold of and moves his feet really well.
items.quote: Ian Garry though, very tough guys to get hold of. Moves his feet really well.

items.claim: Ian Garry needs to use his range, keep strikes long, use his kicks and length, and avoid putting his back on the fence.
items.quote: No he's got to use his range really and it when I say use his range it doesn't just mean keep the strikes long. He has to be really aware of his awareness and his opponent's awareness in the octagon... Use his kicks. Use his length... He needs to circle off quick.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is getting a little bit older now but is definitely still in his prime.
items.quote: Islam Makhachev. He's getting a little bit older now. But he's still in his prime. He's definitely still in his prime

items.claim: Ian Garry's only loss is against Shavkat in a fight where Shavkat won by decision after Ian took the early rounds.
items.quote: the only loss that Ian Garry has had is against Shavkat... Shavkat basically won on decision, but Ian took the first few rounds.
